items.title: File Widerspruch against the Aufhebungs- und Rückforderungsbescheid
items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 08.07.2026 (posting day). Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, a letter sent by post from a German social-law authority counts as delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the 4th day after posting; this day is Sun 12.07.2026 and, for social-law letters, it does not shift for falling on a Sunday. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X, the one-month period starts the day after delivery (13.07.2026). Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, one month later ends on 12.08.2026 (Wednesday). Since 12.08.2026 is a normal working day (not a weekend or NW public holiday), the deadline stays on that date.
